assign.outcome:
**Feedback council done: 44 asks checked by five Sonnet minions. 19 done, 24 partly, 1 not done, 6 the council disagrees on.**

[The verdict page](/framework/ai/2026-09-25/feedback-council/) puts disagreements first, then the not-done rows, each with its vote, evidence and smallest fix.

![Live at 3440](/framework/ai/2026-09-25/feedback-council/shots/council-5-B-3440.png)

The biggest finds: the Live card is fast to click (0.1 to 0.7 s) but a cold load takes 1.7 to 4.6 s; the Landed list prints `[object Object]`; the module-agent tool (`ask_module`) does not exist; AI 2 was never tested with Servex stopped.

Small wanted fixes are in [todo.md](/framework/ai/todo.md), section 1. Left: the checkers made a fast pass (about $2.5 in total), so rows with 3/5 or fewer votes need a human look, and the ~200 lines the owner spoke on cards were only skimmed.
